_comment: Cursor hooks. Install to .cursor/hooks.json (project) or ~/.cursor/hooks.json (user). Project hook commands run from the project root, so the shipped .cursor/hooks/scripts/ paths are correct. User hook commands run from ~/.cursor/ and must use ./hooks/scripts/ paths instead. Cursor v1 exposes ~21 camelCase events. Reference: https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks
_fail_open_warning: Cursor is FAIL-OPEN by default: a hook that crashes, times out, or exits with an unexpected code lets the action through. beforeShellExecution below sets failClosed: true because it is a security gate. Copy that flag onto any hook you add that must not be bypassed by its own failure.
